page.overview:
Who is D-I-S-C-O?

D-I-S-C-O is one of Valentine's henchmen. He confronts Gyro, separating him from an injured Johnny, near Independence Hall, Philadelphia. He is a Stand User, wielding the gauntlet-like Chocolate Disco.

Overall, D-I-S-C-O is a tall, fairly handsome, slim man. He has messy, medium-length, curly dark hair, with a large rectangular hair accessory on the left side of his head. He also has blue eyes and a shaved beard with mustache.

D-I-S-C-O wears a long coat similar to ones worn by the police officers from the 18th century. A belt designed with a handcuff shaped belt buckle is strapped around his waist to hold his coat together. He also wears his Stand, Chocolate Disco, like an arm brace on his left forearm.

D-I-S-C-O has a rather expressionless face and personality. He is a man of few words, speaking only to reveal his Stand's name.
